methodology.summary: Each row is a protocol family in one category (DefiLlama children with the same parent are summed, so Aave V2/V3/V4 are one row). The score is a weighted sum of percentiles across all eligible rows: size 0.3226, 6-month relative TVL growth 0.2258, 6-month TVL added in dollars 0.1828, 30-day fees momentum 0.1075, 30-day DEX volume momentum 0.0753, token attention (24h turnover) 0.086, plus a small bonus per distinct X post from the user's lists. Percentiles cannot saturate, so a fresh listing cannot jump the board on a capped growth number. A family with no TVL 180 days ago is marked New: its relative growth is neutral and it is judged on the dollars it has gathered. CoinGecko turnover sits beside DefiLlama, as a percentile across the 70 rows with a mapped token (turnover and netflow are divided by market cap). An unmapped row scores a neutral 0.5. Nansen smart money is off in this build. CEX, Ponzi and token-locker rows are excluded.

features.title: Stake or queue LINK (stake.link Priority Pool)

features.assertion: the user's LINK drops by exactly the amount, the `Deposit` event's staked + queued equals it, stLINK rises by the staked part (2 wei share rounding), the account queue and `totalQueued` rise by the queued part, and the unqueue returns exactly that LINK and restores both

features.assertion: the user's USDC and the Hub's USDC move by exactly the amount, supply shares are minted and `getUserSuppliedAssets` is the amount within 1 wei; the withdraw returns exactly the supplied assets from the Hub and leaves 0 shares.
